name: cursor-headless
description: Delegate to Cursor Agent from Claude Code or Codex via MCP (ask/plan/implement + cloud plan/review/implement). Claude workflows + /cursor-loop; slash commands for both hosts.

interface.shortDescription: Native Cursor ask/plan/implement tools for Codex and Claude
interface.longDescription: Thin MCP facade over Cursor SDK / cursor-agent. Local cursor_ask/plan/implement plus cloud cursor_cloud_plan/review/implement (VM/pool). Pick Grok low/medium/high and Fast. Works as a Codex plugin and a Claude Code plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use cursor_ask with Grok 4.5 low/medium/high (opt into Fast) by complexity.
Use cursor_plan with Grok 4.5 low/medium/high (opt into Fast) by complexity.
Use cursor_implement with composer-2.5 (opt into Fast) or Grok 4.5 low/medium/high by complexity.
For unattended GitHub VM work use cursor_cloud_plan / cursor_cloud_review / cursor_cloud_implement (repo_url required; CURSOR_API_KEY).
cursor_cloud_review delivery=pr_review posts a GitHub PR review via host gh (pr_url required; collapsed ## Cursor cloud PR review metadata in the review body).
You (parent) set timeout per call (default 1200s). Raise for broad maps; on timeout treat as no result and narrow or raise timeout.
Read progress_summary + job_id from cursor_* envelopes; poll cursor_status(job_id) when parallel tools are available.
Prefer Cursor SDK when an API key is configured (auto); else CLI. Same local MCP tools; override with backend=.
On Windows prefer MCP cursor_* tools (UTF-8) over shelling cursor-agent into a CP-1252 console.
Use /cursor-implement to fan out parallel Cursor workers from Codex.
Use /cursor-review for parent review → Cursor fix → re-review until clean.
On Claude Code, use /cursor-loop to arm /loop with cursor-headless implement/review/babysit ticks.
